svg.title: Quantum measurement: fixed result levels, changing odds
svg.desc: A Hubert visual guide showing two possible spin readings, preparation-dependent odds, and the eigenvalue equation for an ideal fixed-axis measurement.

g.text: Preparation changes the odds. The result levels stay fixed.

svg.text: no third result in the middle

g.text: λ = eigenvalue · certain reading for this state

svg.text: Ideal fixed-axis spin-½ example. Each dot is an independent preparation and measurement.
Other observables can have more outcomes; this two-row picture does not prove superposition.
